known_limits: R55: T-TOADO kich hoat AutoCAD Dogleg shoulder (chong gap net khi grip-drag ne vat can), bo hoan toan nen che giu chu trong suot (BackgroundFill=false theo yeu cau chu so huu), va khoa duong gach chan co dinh o giua toa do X va Y khong bi nhay xuong duoi Y khi xoay/flip. Kiem thu 16/16 goc xoay 360 do va 6 ca grip-drag tren accoreconsole PASS 100% voi troi = 0 tren ban ve Mat bang cap dien trung the.dwg.

R52: them nut VIET CHU (hang thu 5, cot trai, khu Trien khai va thong ke) goi lenh T-VIETCHU: hoi chieu cao chu va net (mm, mac dinh 0.18; 0 = theo layer) roi bam diem + go noi dung de viet chu TEXT 1 dong kieu Tuan_arial ra Model, lap den khi Enter; trong lenh: C = chieu cao, N = net, G = goc xoay, K = kieu chu khac (phai co san trong ban ve). Kieu Tuan_arial dung dung dinh nghia chuan cua tool (arial.ttf, cao 0, rong 1), chua co thi tu tao; kieu Tuan_arial ban ve co cau hinh khac thi dung Tuan_arial_MEPS099 va bao. Nho chieu cao/net/goc lan truoc trong %LOCALAPPDATA%\TVXD\MEPS060\vietchu.ini. T-TOADO cung mac dinh Tuan_arial theo dinh nghia nay (chon kieu khac trong bang). LUU Y: chu Arial (TrueType) khong doi do day khi in du dat net; net chi hien o chu SHX. CHUA bam nut va CHUA viet chu bang chuot trong AutoCAD that (kiem tra bang goi ham trong accoreconsole: tao DBText dung kieu/cao/net, kieu khong co bao loi), chua review doc lap, chua commit Git.

R51: T-TOADO viet lai: quet BAT KY block (khong can co trong thu vien); hien bang chinh (kieu chu mac dinh Tuan_arial, chieu cao chu, goc xoay, so le, quy uoc VN-2000 X=Bac=CAD Y / Y=Dong=CAD X hoac CAD, 2 dong hay 1 dong, them dong TAG/ten block, nen che, khung vien, mui ten + co mui ten, huong dat + khoang cach, chon tay vi tri tung nhan, diem chi vao = diem chen hoac tam khung bao, layer nhan mac dinh TOA_DO mau vang, ap lai dinh dang cho nhan cu); nhan la MLeader (mui ten + MText co nen che) lien ket voi block bang XDATA TVXD_TOADO tren nhan, KHONG ghi gi vao block. Chay lai: cap nhat chu, nhan di theo block da doi, vi tri chu giu nguyen khong troi. Cot TOA DO cua bang T-HTKTBANG dung cung quy uoc. Lenh T-TOADO nam trong menu TAG. Cai dat nho trong %LOCALAPPDATA%\TVXD\MEPS060\toado.ini. Kiem tra accoreconsole: block ngoai thu vien, tao/giu nguyen/di theo block/ap lai dinh dang/chon tay/khong mui ten, tao bang chinh duoc (chua bam). CHUA bam bang chinh va CHUA xem hinh nhan that trong AutoCAD, chua review doc lap, chua commit Git. Doi so voi R50: R50 chi nhan MText cho block HTKT.

R50: lenh nhan toa do doi ten thanh T-TOADO (khong con T-HTKTTOADO) va co them dong 'T-TOADO - NHAN TOA DO X, Y CUA BLOCK' trong menu TAG cua thanh cong cu (cung nhom T-HTKTNHAN / T-HTKTDOINHAN / T-HTKTTLNHAN). Nhan la MText co nen che, kieu chu Tuan_arial, dich duoc bang grip/MOVE; chay lai chi doi noi dung. Kiem tra: ten lenh dang ky = T-TOADO, danh sach Actions co T-TOADO, logic tao/cap nhat nhan chay dung trong accoreconsole voi block gia. CHUA bam dong menu TAG trong AutoCAD that, chua xem nen che hien thi that, chua thu thu vien HTKT that, chua review doc lap, chua commit Git.

R47: MEPS_DANHMUC xuat theo DUNG MAU INPUT\DANH MUC BAN VE.dwg: to giay A3 420x297 (hinh chu nhat DEFPOINTS) + khung KHUNG_MEPS_DM mau vang ACI 2 net 0.50 mm (le trai 25, con lai 5); moi to co 2 bang canh nhau, moi bang 36 hang chuan (cao 7.04, chu cao 2.2 Arial, cot 11/19.8/121/18, tieu de 10.56, hang tieu de cot 7.04); bang ve bang LINE + MTEXT tren layer MEPS_DANH_MUC; ten dai tu xuong dong theo do rong that cua chu Arial; het hang thi sang bang moi, het 2 bang thi sang to khung moi ben phai (cach 450). Cap nhat (MEPS_DANHMUC_CAPNHAT) chon bat ky doi tuong cua danh muc, xoa het ban cu va ve lai. Kiem tra trong AutoCAD that tren ban sao: 94/94 duong ke, 292/292 chu, khung va nut khop file mau (lech chu toi da 0.116); ve lai khi cap nhat xoa het doi tuong cu; xem anh. CHUA bam nut/nhap o trong cua so danh muc bang chuot, chua review doc lap, chua commit Git. Doc Sheet Set that (file DST) trong bien ban nay chua thu lai; kiem tra dung du lieu mau gia.

R45: nhan dang loai dim TONG QUAT tu chinh dong chu cua kieu dim (DIMPOST), nen 2D60, 2D110, QĐ 2D60, QĐ 2D110, VX 70-TD... deu vao thong ke (sua loi cu doc 'QĐ 2D110' thanh 'QĐ D2'); dim khong nhan ra ten van duoc tinh o nhom 'KHAC: ...'; cua so doi chieu so dim voi tong dim cua khong gian hien tai (CHUA DU / Du dim). Bang CAD: chu tieng Viet Arial, o vua chu khong xuong dong, canh giua (ten canh trai), nam tren layer E-BANG (ACI 7), duong lien, khong thua huong layer/kieu duong phuc hien hanh. Kiem trong AutoCAD that (acad.exe, ban sao 04.Mb_thong_tin_len _lac.dwg): 759/759 dim, 4 nhom, tong 11191.21 m khop so do doc lap; hoa so QA, da khoi phuc ho so hien hanh cua chu so huu. Chua bam nut menu bang chuot; chua review doc lap, chua commit Git.
